# stream platform

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:streamPlatform`](gmeow-streamPlatform.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/streamPlatform>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/observations`](../../slices/observations.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The platform hosting the sensor(s) producing this stream — a vehicle, vessel, aircraft, buoy, or fixed station. Non-functional: a stream may migrate across platforms over its lifetime (e.g. a device handed from one drone to another).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Stream`](../classes/gmeow-Stream.md) -> [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:streamPlatform`](gmeow-streamPlatform.md) from [`gmeow:Stream`](../classes/gmeow-Stream.md) to [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:Stream`](../classes/gmeow-Stream.md), [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to name the platform hosting the sensor(s) of a stream — a vehicle, vessel, aircraft, buoy, or fixed station.

### Avoid when

- Avoid conflating it with the sensor itself ([`gmeow:streamSensor`](gmeow-streamSensor.md)) or the tracked subject ([`gmeow:streamOf`](gmeow-streamOf.md)); the platform is the host, distinct from the device that reads. Do not assume a single platform — a stream may migrate.

### How to use

- Bind the hosting platform agent; assert several across the stream's life when the device is handed between platforms (it is non-functional), keeping each platform claim alongside the others.

### Examples

- ex:roverTrack [`gmeow:streamPlatform`](gmeow-streamPlatform.md) ex:droneA.
